A little about us

Ideas, imagination
and a little code.

Cyber Arcade Studio is an independent digital studio focused on creating mobile games and practical applications. We bring together development and design to turn ideas into products people can enjoy and use.

From playful experiences like Jumpy Land to everyday productivity with Scanozo, each release reflects our goal: make digital experiences simple, engaging and accessible.
